reviewItem.question: For "Kubernetes Ingress API Group `networking.k8s.io/v1beta1`: In v3, the Kubernetes Ingress API Group `networking.k8s.io/v1beta1` (removed since Kubernetes v1.22)…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: Traefik v3 removes support for the Kubernetes Ingress API Group networking.k8s.io/v1beta1; users must migrate to networking.k8s.io/v1.
